title: ak usage --json (usage-v1)
description: Quota and usage of each account the kit can see, one row per credential identity. Never contains a secret value, an account identity (e-mail, organisation, id) or a token. The endpoints behind it are vendor-internal and unofficial: a row whose source changed shape reports status `error`, never a crash. Consumers check `schema` and `interface` before reading anything else; additional top-level keys may appear in later minor versions.

rows.description: Ordered: CLI order of providers.toml, then @default, then profile names sorted.

cli.description: The CLI (claude, codex, ...) or the provider (zai) that owns the credential.

default.description: Since 0.5.2, present only on the account a bare `ak <cli>` launches by AGENTKIT_DEFAULT_PROFILE_<CLI> (for `pick`: the portable-login account ranked first).

kinds.description: Every kind that shares this credential identity.

plan.description: The provider's own plan label when reported.

windows.description: The provider's own windows; never merged into an invented quota. Empty unless status is ok.

used.description: Optional (additive): the absolute amount used, when the source reports it (Z.AI credits).

limit.description: Optional (additive): the window's absolute limit, in the same unit as used.

unit.description: Optional (additive): what used and limit count (credits, tokens).

source.description: The adapter id (anthropic-oauth, chatgpt-wham, zai-quota) or `none`.

error.description: One line, never a secret. Set for every status except ok and unsupported.

reason.description: One line explaining an `unsupported` row; null otherwise.

connected.description: Optional (additive), unsupported rows only: whether the account is connected anyway — a login found (file, credential variable name or Keychain item presence; nothing is read) or its provider key set. Absent when it cannot be told.

resets_available.description: Optional (additive): the limit resets the account holds, when the source reports them (Codex: rate_limit_reset_credits.available_count). Absent when not reported.
